name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: A Gmail mailbox read over IMAP and sent through SMTP, with an app password.

address.label: Gmail address
address.hint: Optional when the gmail credential's address is set. The app password comes from the credential and is never stored on the source.

mark_read_in_gmail.label: Mark as read in Gmail
mark_read_in_gmail.hint: When you read or unread a message in Flowpad, do the same in the Gmail mailbox. Off: Flowpad only follows what you do in Gmail.

imap_host.label: IMAP host
imap_host.hint: host[:port]; imap://host:port for a plain (non-TLS) connection

smtp_host.label: SMTP host
smtp_host.hint: host[:port]; smtp://host:port for a plain (non-TLS) connection
